cc:Work.dc:title: PHYS31_QUARTIC_PROFILE_SPLITTING
cc:Work.dc:description: PHYS31 cached-result figure. Left: two exact-defined symmetric probability densities on [-1,1], 501 display samples, equal mu2=1/3 and delta_mu4=8/315. Right: upper and lower quartic profile-difference coefficients from the existing raw log-energy calculation. Fixed inputs and equal retained A_j within each branch; no finite-width certification, no new science execution.
